label: Grain Rot sandboxes
description: How Grain Rot sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine.

notes: UE4SS and the Thunderstore shimloader are not installed by this app. Install them into the game's binaries folder once; mods then live under shimloader/mod (Lua folders) and shimloader/pak (.pak files).
Hard links are the default: the loader reads real files, the game folder and the staging folder are almost always the same drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
The loader writes each mod's settings into shimloader/cfg the first time it runs. Those files belong to the game folder rather than to the sandbox.

Anti-cheat: if the game ships an anti-cheat that blocks injected loaders, launch it in the mode that disables it before using a sandbox. This rule set was derived from the r2modman and Gale game lists and has not been checked against every title.
